picks.why: Commanders back Jacory Croskey-Merritt has 47 carries for 142 yards (47.3 per game, 3.02 yards per carry) against a Colts run defense allowing 5.08 yards per carry and 10 runs of 10-plus, so his 61.0 rush-yard line in IND at WAS is beatable: 15.7 carries at even 4.00 yards per carry is 62.8, and at the 5.08 Indianapolis has allowed it is 79.7.
